name: normal
description: Balanced and adaptable, Normal-types specialize in utility, support, and unpredictability despite lacking super-effective coverage.

effects.effect: Normal-type Pokémon have no super-effective offensive matchups but are weak only to Fighting.
The ability Scrappy allows Normal moves to hit Ghost-type Pokémon.
Normalize converts all of a Pokémon’s moves into Normal-type with a 20% power boost.
Moves like Hyper Beam and Boomburst are among the most powerful in the game.
Held items like Silk Scarf and Normal Gem increase Normal-type move power by 20–30%.
Normal-type Pokémon often have wide move pools for excellent type coverage.
The move Conversion can change a user’s type to match its first move.

name: fighting
description: Disciplined and intense, Fighting-types rely on physical strength and technique to overpower opponents in direct combat.

effects.effect: Fighting-type moves are super effective against Dark, Ice, Normal, Rock, and Steel types.
The ability Justified boosts Attack when hit by a Dark-type move.
Steadfast boosts Speed after flinching, while Iron Fist enhances punching moves.
Fighting-type moves are boosted by items like Black Belt and Fist Plate.
The Fighting Gem boosts the next Fighting move by 30% before being consumed.
Close Combat is a high-risk, high-reward staple that lowers the user's defenses.
Moves like Detect and Reversal give tactical advantages in tight situations.

name: flying
description: Swift and unbound, Flying-types dominate the skies, using aerial agility and wind-based tactics to outmaneuver foes.

effects.effect: Flying-type Pokémon are unaffected by entry hazards like Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap ability, unless grounded by Gravity or Iron Ball.
They are immune to Ground-type moves unless grounded, and immune to Rototiller effects and most terrains
The ability Gale Wings grants priority to Flying-type moves when the user's HP is full.
Delta Stream removes Flying-type weaknesses to Electric, Ice, and Rock by simulating high-altitude winds.
The ability Aerilate converts Normal moves into Flying-type and boosts their power by about 20%.
Items like Sharp Beak and Sky Plate boost Flying-type move power by 20% when held, while the Flying Gem grants a 30% boost once.
Holding a Coba Berry reduces damage from a super-effective Flying-type attack.

name: poison
description: Toxic and corrosive, Poison-types slowly wear down enemies with status effects while resisting a wide range of threats.

effects.effect: Poison-type Pokémon are immune to poison and badly poison status effects.
The ability Poison Point may poison attackers on contact.
Toxic can never miss when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.
Poison Touch can inflict poison even with moves that don’t normally have that effect.
Items like Poison Barb and Toxic Plate boost Poison-type move power by 20%.
Poison Gem boosts a single Poison-type move by 30% and is consumed afterward.
Moves like Venoshock double in power if the target is already poisoned.

name: ground
description: Closely tied to the earth, Ground-types are strong and stable, often nullifying electrical threats and shaking the battlefield.

effects.effect: Ground-type Pokémon are immune to Electric-type moves unless affected by abilities like Mold Breaker.
Abilities like Sand Force boost Ground, Rock, and Steel moves during a Sandstorm.
Ground moves like Earthquake hit all grounded Pokémon unless protected by Flying-type or Levitate.
Moves like Spikes and Toxic Spikes can only be set by grounded users and affect grounded foes.
Soft Sand and Earth Plate boost Ground-type move power by 20%.
Ground Gem boosts a single Ground-type move by 30% and is then consumed.
Moves like Dig and Bulldoze provide strategic control and support in doubles battles.

name: rock
description: Unyielding and grounded, Rock-types stand firm against adversity using sheer defenses and powerful, weighty moves.

effects.effect: Rock-type Pokémon take no damage from Sandstorm when holding the ability Sand Rush or Sand Force.
The ability Sturdy ensures they survive with 1 HP if hit by a potential OHKO from full HP.
Solid Rock and Filter reduce damage taken from super-effective hits by 25%.
The move Stealth Rock sets entry hazards that damage incoming opponents depending on their weakness to Rock.
Items like Rock Incense, Hard Stone, and Stone Plate increase Rock-type move power by 20% when held.
The Rock Gem gives a one-time 30% boost to an Rock-type move before use.
Rollout and Rock Blast can hit multiple times for tedious chipping away at foe defenses.

name: bug
description: Often underestimated, Bug-types overwhelm foes with numbers, speed, and tactics rooted in nature’s resilience.

effects.effect: Bug-type Pokémon resist Grass, Fighting, and Ground moves, especially in forests and grassy terrain.
Abilities like Swarm increase Bug-type move power by 50% when below 1/3 HP.
Shield Dust prevents additional effects from damaging moves, making Bug-types immune to flinching, stat drops, or burns.
Items like Silver Powder and Insect Plate increase Bug-type move power by 20%.
The Bug Gem boosts the next Bug-type move by 30% and is consumed after use.
U-turn and First Impression allow Bug-types to strike early and escape.
Compound Eyes boosts the accuracy of Bug moves like Sleep Powder or String Shot.

name: ghost
description: Mysterious and intangible, Ghost-types phase through danger and wield spiritual power that unsettles and curses opponents.

effects.effect: Ghost-type Pokémon are immune to Normal and Fighting-type moves.
The ability Cursed Body has a chance to disable moves that make contact.
Moves like Shadow Sneak allow Ghost-types to strike first with priority.
Trick-or-Treat adds the Ghost type to an opponent, opening them up to super-effective hits.
Spell Tag and Spooky Plate boost Ghost-type move power by 20%.
Ghost Gem boosts a single Ghost-type move by 30% and is consumed afterward.
Phantom Force allows the user to vanish for a turn, avoiding attacks before hitting hard.

name: steel
description: Unyielding and highly defensive, Steel-types stand as fortresses, resisting nearly all forms of attack with unrivaled endurance.

effects.effect: Steel-type Pokémon resist 10 types and are immune to Poison.
The ability Bulletproof grants immunity to ball and bomb moves like Shadow Ball or Sludge Bomb.
Steelworker increases Steel-type move power if the Pokémon is not originally Steel-type.
Iron Barbs deals damage to attackers that make physical contact.
Held items like Metal Coat and Iron Plate increase Steel-type move power by 20%.
Steel Gem boosts a single Steel-type move by 30% and is consumed afterward.
Moves like Iron Defense and Gyro Ball are often used for tanking and countering speedy foes.

name: fire
description: Embodying passion and destructive energy, Fire-type Pokémon specialize in overwhelming foes with raw power and status effects like burn.

effects.effect: Fire-type Pokémon cannot be burned, providing immunity to the burn status condition.
When Sunny Day is active, Fire-type moves increase in power by 50%, and some Fire-type moves like Solar Beam charge instantly.
The Blaze ability powers up Fire-type moves by 50% when the user’s HP is below one-third.
Flash Fire grants immunity to Fire-type attacks and boosts Fire-type move power by 50% if hit by one.
Steam Engine activates when hit by a Fire or Water move, sharply increasing the user's Speed.
Items like Charcoal, Flame Plate, and Magmarizer boost Fire-type move power by 20% when held.
The Fire Gem boosts a Fire-type move by 30% once, then disappears.
Resonates strongly with moves like Will-O-Wisp, which inflicts burn and halves the Attack of physical attackers.
The move Burn Up removes the user's Fire typing after use, nullifying future Fire-type weaknesses.
A held Passho Berry reduces damage from a super-effective Water-type attack.

name: water
description: Fluid and adaptable, Water types dominate with versatility and strong synergy with terrain and weather effects like Rain Dance.

effects.effect: Water-type Pokémon cannot be affected by the move Water Sport, which already weakens Fire-type moves.
When Rain Dance is active, Water-type moves receive a 50% power boost and moves like Thunder and Hurricane gain perfect accuracy.
The Torrent ability increases Water-type move power by 50% when HP is below one-third.
Storm Drain and Water Absorb provide complete immunity to Water-type moves, healing or boosting Special Attack instead.
Dry Skin heals the Pokémon during rain but makes them vulnerable to Fire-type attacks.
Items like Mystic Water, Sea Incense, and Splash Plate raise Water-type move power by 20%.
The Water Gem gives a one-time 30% damage boost to a Water-type move and is consumed after use.
Soak changes the target's type to pure Water, altering resistances and effectiveness.
Surf and Whirlpool can hit multiple opponents or trap foes in battle.
Rindo Berry provides protection from super-effective Electric-type attacks.

name: grass
description: Masters of nature and plant life, Grass types thrive in environments filled with flora. They often rely on status moves and regeneration to outlast foes.

effects.effect: Grass-type Pokémon are immune to powder and spore-based moves such as Sleep Powder, Stun Spore, and Leech Seed, and they can't be affected by the Effect Spore ability.
When Grassy Terrain is active, all Grass-type moves receive a 30% power boost and grounded Pokémon heal slightly each turn.
The Overgrow ability increases the power of Grass-type moves by 50% when the user’s HP falls below one-third.
Sap Sipper grants immunity to Grass-type moves and boosts the user's Attack stat by one stage upon being hit by one.
Flower Veil prevents ally Grass-type Pokémon’s stats from being lowered by opponents or effects.
Flower Shield raises the Defense stat of all Grass-type Pokémon on the field by one stage.
Rototiller boosts both Attack and Special Attack stats of all grounded Grass-type Pokémon.
Forest’s Curse temporarily adds the Grass type to the target, making it more vulnerable to Fire, Ice, Poison, Flying, and Bug.
Items like Miracle Seed, Rose Incense, and Meadow Plate increase the power of Grass-type moves by 20% when held.
The Grass Gem grants a one-time 30% power boost to a Grass-type move, then is consumed after use.
A held Rindo Berry reduces the damage taken from a super-effective Grass-type move once.

name: electric
description: Charged with energy, Electric-types strike fast and hard, often disrupting foes with paralysis or speed control.

effects.effect: Electric-type Pokémon are immune to paralysis when hit by their own moves, and the ability Motor Drive grants Speed boosts when they would be hit by an Electric attack instead of taking damage.
The ability Lightning Rod draws all Electric-type moves to the user, grants immunity, and raises Special Attack by one stage.
Volt Absorb and similar abilities (e.g. Lightning Rod variants) restore a quarter of HP upon being hit by an Electric move.
During Electric Terrain, moves like Thunder gain perfect accuracy and Ground-type Pokémon can’t be put to sleep.
Item boosts: Magnet, Zap Plate, and Amplifier increase Electric-type move power by 20% when held.
The Electric Gem offers a one-time 30% boost to an Electric-type attack and is then consumed.
Moves like Ion Deluge convert Normal-type moves into Electric-type, enabling STAB for Electric-focused users.
Holding a Rindo Berry reduces damage from a super-effective Electric-type attack.

name: psychic
description: Masters of the mind and paranormal forces, Psychic-types excel at status moves and mental manipulation to control the battlefield.

effects.effect: Psychic-type Pokémon are immune to confusion from Psychic Terrain and prevent priority moves like Sucker Punch when grounded.
The ability Psychic Surge automatically activates Psychic Terrain upon entry, boosting Psychic moves and nullifying priority conditions.
Synchronize spreads status ailments like paralysis, poison, or burn back to the attacker.
Magic Guard prevents indirect damage from Poison, weather, entry hazards, and Leech Seed.
Items like Twisted Spoon, Mind Plate, and Psychic Seed boost Psychic-type power or stats.
The Psychic Gem grants a one-time 30% move power boost before being consumed.
Moves like Future Sight and Psychic Terrain interactions can lock in delayed hits or shield allies from priority moves.

name: ice
description: Cold-hearted and precise, Ice-types freeze away obstacles, though their offensive strength often comes at a defensive cost.

effects.effect: Ice-type Pokémon are immune to hail damage while using abilities like Ice Body or Snow Cloak.
The ability Snow Warning summons hail when entering battle, enhancing the effectiveness of hail-powered moves.
The ability Slush Rush doubles Speed in hail weather, letting Ice-types strike faster and harder.
Moves like Aurora Veil reduce damage taken by allies and amplify defensive resilience under hail.
Items like Icicle Plate and Never-Melt Ice raise Ice-type move power by 20% when held.
The Ice Gem allows a one-time 30% boost to an Ice-type attack before vanishing.
Frost Breath guarantees critical hits, while moves like Powder Snow can freeze opponents.

name: dragon
description: Legendary and awe-inspiring, Dragon-types wield mythical power and often dominate with raw force and sweeping elemental moves.

effects.effect: Dragon-type Pokémon boost the power of Dragon moves by 50% when under the power-up effects of Multiscale or Draconic Aura features.
They are immune to effects from the move Fairy Lock and gain protection from Dragon Dance setups.
The presence of Weakness Policy can turn a super-effective hit from Ice, Dragon, or Fairy moves into a formidable counterattack.
Dragon’s Fury storm: the move Dragon’s Rage always deals 40 HP, ignoring defenses.
The ability Reveal Armor prevents stat drops from critical hits or special attacks.
Items like Dragon Fang and Draco Plate increase Dragon-type move power by 20% when held.
The Dragon Gem provides a one-time 30% boost to a Dragon-type move before being consumed.

name: dark
description: Cunning and ruthless, Dark-types use underhanded tactics, exploiting fear and surprise to win their battles.

effects.effect: Dark-type Pokémon are immune to Psychic-type moves.
The ability Dark Aura boosts Dark-type move power for all Pokémon on the field.
Moves like Knock Off and Foul Play capitalize on opponent’s items or stats for added damage.
Prankster Pokémon can’t affect Dark-types with status moves due to their innate resistance to trickery.
Black Glasses and Dread Plate increase Dark-type move power by 20%.
Dark Gem boosts a single Dark-type move by 30% and is consumed afterward.
The ability Stakeout doubles damage to opponents who switch in.

name: fairy
description: Enigmatic and radiant, Fairy-types channel purity and mysticism to ward off darkness and dragons alike.

effects.effect: Fairy-type Pokémon are immune to Dragon-type moves.
The ability Misty Surge activates Misty Terrain, which halves Dragon damage and prevents status conditions on grounded Pokémon.
Moves like Dazzling Gleam and Moonblast are powerful tools for multi-targeting or Special STAB.
Pixilate turns Normal-type moves into Fairy-type and boosts their power by 20%.
Fairy-type moves get boosted by items like Pixie Plate and Roseli Berry protects against one super-effective Fairy hit.
Fairy Gem grants a one-time 30% move power boost before being consumed.
The move Crafty Shield blocks status moves for the team.
